Measures.title: Proportion of patients with HF who have a documentation of their HF clinical type (HFrEF, HFmrEF, HFpEF)
Measures.Numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their HF clinical type.

Measures.title: Proportion of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings
Measures.Numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings.

Measures.title: Proportion of patients with HF who have their NPs measured
Measures.Numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their NPs levels.

Domain 3: Initial treatment.Main (1) Beta-blocker prescription for H: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol in the absence of any contraindications.
Domain 3: Initial treatment.Numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol.
Domain 3: Initial treatment.Denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, and nebivolol.

Main (2) ACE inhibitor/ARB/ARNI prescrip.description: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI in the absence of any contraindications.
Main (2) ACE inhibitor/ARB/ARNI prescrip.Numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed an ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI.
Main (2) ACE inhibitor/ARB/ARNI prescrip.Denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for ACE inhibitors, ARBs and ARNI.

Main (3) Diuretic therapy for HF with fl.description: Proportion of patients with HF who are prescribed diuretic therapy if they have evidence of fluid retention.
Main (3) Diuretic therapy for HF with fl.Numerator: Number of patients with HF, with evidence of fluid retention who are prescribed diuretic therapy.
Main (3) Diuretic therapy for HF with fl.Denominator: Number of patients with HF who have evidence of fluid retention and no contraindications for diuretic therapy.

Main (4) MRA for HFrEF.description: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed an MRA in the absence of any contraindications.
